verdict.rationale: Weaviate is an API-first database. It ships official client libraries in Python, JS/TS, Go and Java, and documents API-driven operations such as creating collections, configuring tenants in the collection definition, and backups, plus a GraphQL interface and an official MCP server. However, no evidence states that every UI capability (e.g. the Weaviate Cloud console) is also exposed through the API. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, evidence covering cloud console management actions via API, independent corroboration of full programmatic coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: install one of the official client libraries, available in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java
set `autoTenantCreation` to `true` in the collection definition
Enable and configure the Weaviate MCP server so LLMs and IDE assistants can interact with your Weaviate instance.
Choice of backing up an entire instance, or selected collections only
